items.title: Descent of regularity along a split exact conormal sequence for immersions of spaces
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter spaces-more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms of Spaces)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file spaces-more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: For immersions i : Z -> Y and j : Y -> X of algebraic spaces over S with j locally of finite presentation and the conormal sequence 0 -> i^*C_{Y/X} -> C_{Z/X} -> C_{Z/Y} -> 0 of the chapter's transitivity lemma exact and locally split, the lemma proves three permanence statements: quasi-regularity of the composite j i forces quasi-regularity of i; H1-regularity of j i forces H1-regularity of i; and Koszul-regularity of both j and j i forces Koszul-regularity of i. The retained proof is written: immediate from the case of schemes via Divisors, lemma permanence-regular-immersion, quoted by name, since the hypotheses and conclusions are all etale-local on charts; the split conormal input transfers verbatim. Retained author proof at lines 10690-10693.
